title: Generate the AI clips
summary: One clip per shot, sequentially (provider concurrency 1). connector mode: writes generate/requests.json; the agent submits each through the Krea MCP connector and records job ids / result URLs in jobs.json; rerun downloads finished clips. api mode: upload → submit → poll → download with $KREA_API_KEY. Resumable: finished clips are never regenerated; out-of-credit (402) or busy (429) blocks with the shot to resume from.
checks: every shot has a downloaded clip
